req.title: Rate limit not enforced
req.statement: The system shall not throttle single-client request rates below 60/min.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-039 states the system shall NOT throttle single-client request rates below 60/min. This means 60 rapid sequential requests must all return HTTP 2xx. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — 60 requests all succeed with 2xx; (2) boundary BVA — exactly 60 requests at the threshold, every single one must be 2xx, catching off-by-one mutations in any hypothetical rate-limit counter; (3) negative NEG — verifying that a clearly invalid request (bad payload) returns 4xx, confirming the client distinguishes error classes and the test harness is sensitive to status codes. Since the SUT has no rate-limiting middleware, all 60 requests must pass. Tests assert exact status codes and exact response counts to kill constant-mutation and comparison-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_rate_limit_60_requests_all_succeed_positive
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
No rate-limiting middleware is active below 60 req/min
actions: Send 60 sequential GET /tasks/ requests using TestClient
expected: Zero responses return HTTP 429 or any 4xx/5xx
trace: R-TASK-039: system shall not throttle single-client request rates below 60/min
EP: 60 requests is the nominal allowed partition — all must succeed
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_rate_limit_60_requests_all_succeed_positive():
    client = TestClient(app)
    responses = [client.get("/tasks/") for _ in range(60)]
    status_codes = [r.status_code for r in responses]
    assert len(status_codes) == 60
    non_2xx = [sc for sc in status_codes if sc < 200 or sc >= 300]
    assert non_2xx == [], f"Expected all 2xx but got non-2xx codes: {non_2xx}"
    assert all(sc == 200 for sc in status_codes), (
        f"Not all 200: {set(status_codes)}"
    )

test_rate_limit_60_requests_all_succeed_positive()

tests.name: test_rate_limit_boundary_exactly_60_requests
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: Send exactly 60 GET /tasks/ requests (the threshold value from R-TASK-039)
Assert every single response is HTTP 200
Also verify request 59 (index 58) and request 60 (index 59) are both 200
expected: Total count of 200 responses equals exactly 60
trace: R-TASK-039: threshold is 60 req/min — boundary at exactly 60
BVA: test at N=60 (threshold), N-1=59, and N+1 not required to throttle
Catches off-by-one mutation: if limit were 59 instead of 60, request 60 would fail
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_rate_limit_boundary_exactly_60_requests():
    client = TestClient(app)
    responses = [client.get("/tasks/") for _ in range(60)]
    assert len(responses) == 60
    assert responses[0].status_code == 200
    assert responses[58].status_code == 200
    assert responses[59].status_code == 200
    count_200 = sum(1 for r in responses if r.status_code == 200)
    assert count_200 == 60, f"Expected 60 x 200, got {count_200} x 200"
    count_throttled = sum(1 for r in responses if r.status_code == 429)
    assert count_throttled == 0, f"Got {count_throttled} throttled (429) responses"

test_rate_limit_boundary_exactly_60_requests()

tests.name: test_rate_limit_invalid_payload_returns_4xx_negative
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: Send a POST /tasks/ request with an empty title (violates min_length=1)
Send a POST /tasks/ request with title exceeding 100 chars
Verify both return HTTP 422 (client validation error, not throttle)
expected: Neither returns HTTP 429 (rate limit) or HTTP 200
trace: R-TASK-039: error pathway — HTTP 4xx on client error
NEG: invalid payloads must return 4xx, not be confused with rate-limit 429
Catches mutation that changes 422 to 200 or suppresses validation
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_rate_limit_invalid_payload_returns_4xx_negative():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r_empty = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "", "completed": False})
    assert r_empty.status_code == 422, (
        f"Expected 422 for empty title, got {r_empty.status_code}"
    )
    assert r_empty.status_code != 200
    assert r_empty.status_code != 429
    long_title = "X" * 101
    r_long = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": long_title, "completed": False})
    assert r_long.status_code == 422, (
        f"Expected 422 for over-length title, got {r_long.status_code}"
    )
    assert r_long.status_code != 200
    assert r_long.status_code != 429

test_rate_limit_invalid_payload_returns_4xx_negative()

tests.name: test_rate_limit_59_requests_all_succeed_boundary_minus_one
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
trace: BVA + boundary-mutation: catches mutation of 60->61 in rate-limit counter
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_rate_limit_59_requests_all_succeed_boundary_minus_one():
    client = TestClient(app)
    responses = [client.get("/tasks/") for _ in range(59)]
    assert len(responses) == 59
    status_codes = [r.status_code for r in responses]
    assert responses[0].status_code == 200
    assert responses[58].status_code == 200
    count_200 = sum(1 for sc in status_codes if sc == 200)
    assert count_200 == 59, f"Expected 59 x 200, got {count_200}"
    count_non_2xx = sum(1 for sc in status_codes if sc < 200 or sc >= 300)
    assert count_non_2xx == 0, f"Got {count_non_2xx} non-2xx responses"

test_rate_limit_59_requests_all_succeed_boundary_minus_one()

tests.name: test_rate_limit_mixed_endpoints_60_requests_all_succeed
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
Multiple endpoints available: GET /tasks/, GET /tasks/{id}, POST /tasks/
actions: Send 60 requests mixing GET /tasks/, GET /tasks/1, and POST /tasks/ with valid payload
expected: No response is HTTP 429 or any non-2xx
trace: R-TASK-039: single-client rate not throttled below 60/min across endpoint types
DT: decision table covers multiple endpoint combinations within the 60-req window
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_rate_limit_mixed_endpoints_60_requests_all_succeed():
    client = TestClient(app)
    results = []
    for i in range(60):
        if i % 3 == 0:
            r = client.get("/tasks/")
        elif i % 3 == 1:
            r = client.get("/tasks/1")
        else:
            r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": f"Task {i}", "completed": False})
        results.append(r.status_code)
    assert len(results) == 60
    non_2xx = [sc for sc in results if sc < 200 or sc >= 300]
    assert non_2xx == [], f"Non-2xx responses found: {non_2xx}"
    throttled = [sc for sc in results if sc == 429]
    assert throttled == [], f"Throttled responses: {throttled}"
    count_2xx = sum(1 for sc in results if 200 <= sc < 300)
    assert count_2xx == 60

test_rate_limit_mixed_endpoints_60_requests_all_succeed()
